references.label: R-D-A top lanes
references.description: The three rollover lanes sit above the pop bumpers at the top of the playfield.

references.context: Shoot Link as the next major shot to light its 2x insert.
references.label: Link shot and lock
references.description: Link is the left-center shot and ball-holding mechanism.

references.context: Hit the trapped Link ball before the timer ends.
references.label: Trapped Link ball
references.description: A live ball held between the Link posts in the left-center Link lane.

references.label: AMP drop-target bank
references.description: The AMP targets protect the center bullseye and inner suit targets.

references.label: Unobtainium shot
references.description: Unobtainium is the upper-center shot used for its Jackpot and Final Battle start.

references.label: N-A-V-I target bank
references.description: The N-A-V-I targets are grouped in the right-center playfield.

references.label: Eywa captive ball
references.description: Center-right captive ball used for Mystery, character progress, and Link and AMP Suit Jackpots.

references.label: Seeds targets
references.description: Two standup targets above the right outlane used for Seeds and alternating Link Jackpots.

references.label: Left orbit
references.description: Spinner orbit used for character progress, Bomber Battle, and AMP Suit Jackpots.

references.label: Right orbit
references.description: Spinner orbit used for character progress, Bomber Battle, and AMP Suit Jackpots.

references.label: Banshee ramp
references.description: Single playfield ramp used for Banshee, character progress, and AMP Suit Jackpots.

references.label: AMP Suit bullseye
references.description: Center target behind the A-M-P bank used to start and score AMP Suit Multiball.
